class.name: FmodSound3DSettings
class.brief_description: FMOD's global 3D audio settings, read from Project Settings.
class.description: Set in Project Settings under [code]Fmod/3D Settings[/code], and applied when FMOD initializes.

members.member: The number of game units per meter. In 2D, set it to the number of pixels per meter, or attenuation is wrong.
Scales the doppler effect: 1 is physically accurate, 0 disables it.
Scales how fast sounds attenuate with distance, for those using FMOD's built-in rolloff.
